date_range_or_sols: FMARS 'Meet the Crew' page (live/current as of Sept 2026), section 'CREW 19 - Tiriganiaq'. Lists 6 named individuals under this section; sol reports (SRC-fmars-c19-2026-mission-updates) consistently describe only 5 people physically present in the habitat during simulation ('we are a crew of five', sol-1) with the 6th (the dust-deposition experiment's off-site PI) explicitly described as remote mission support, not part of the on-station crew (sol-5). Treated here as the source for the 5 on-station Crew Member records only.
